Ladies and gentlemen, I am pleased to make the following announcement in my capacity as President of the Security Council. With respect to the process of selection of the next Secretary-General. The third round of straw polls has taken place. Each candidate will be informed of the results through the respective permanent representatives of nominating member states. The President of the General Assembly will also be informed that the straw poll has been conducted. I thank you.
